styleSelection.reason: Warm stone planes, crisp window and arch structure, and a blue sky with the form carried by transparent washes and selective sepia drawing.

families.referenceCue: Connected pale blue sky with broken white cloud flecks, bounded by the irregular roofline.
Sunlit ochre central gable, tall left tower, arched openings, and broad pale facade planes.
Right-hand wing and side planes recede into cooler, darker stone and roof shadows.
Irregular green tree crown in front of the right facade; connected leaf masses with light gaps.
Dark signpost, traffic lights, cropped street edge, and small foreground stone details.
